Classification: document is an invoice (contains "Rechnung"/"Invoice", invoice date, totals, VAT lines).

Extraction plan and field-by-field reasoning (concise):
- Locate invoice-like headers: "Rechnung / Invoice", "Fakturadatum / Invoice Date", "Gesamtbetrag / Total Amount", "Umsatzsteuer / Output Tax" — present → proceed.
- Invoice.Date: found "Fakturadatum 11.10.2023" → Invoice.Date = "11.10.2023".
- Sender.VatId: two VAT IDs appear: "Ihre USt.-ID-Nr. ATU22642807" (your VAT no. — the buyer) and "Unsere USt.-ID-Nr. ATU16040004" (our VAT no.). Schema asks for Sender.VatId → use "ATU16040004".
- GrandTotal.Amount: "Gesamtbetrag 23.988,80" → numeric value = 23988.80 (preserve decimals).
- Vat.Rate / Net.Amount / Vat.Amount: VAT block shows "Umsatzsteuer 10,00 % von 21.808,00 EUR" and VAT amount displayed as "2.180,80". Interpret:
  - Vat.Rate = 10 (strip percent per rules).
  - Net.Amount = 21808.00 (from 21.808,00).
  - Vat.Amount = 2180.80 (from 2.180,80).
- No inference beyond visible values; decimals preserved; all values match invoice sections.

Note: If multiple VAT groups existed, would list them; here a single 10% group is present.
